name: A Sri Lankan dataset of Tibial shaft X-ray images for fracture detection and classification
description: This dataset includes tibial shaft X-rays collected from Ashraf Memorial Hospital, Kalmunai. This dataset can be used for tasks like object detection, image analysis, fracture classification, and segmentation. The X-ray images were organized into 2 folders, which are annotated data and raw data. The X-ray images are further organized into annotated and raw data. The annotated dataset contains 253 fractured tibial shaft X-ray images, with fracture regions annotated for object detection. The raw data include 244 non-fractured tibial shaft X-ray images collected from 204 patients, together with the corresponding raw images of the annotated fractured cases. All the images are in .jpg, .png or .jpeg format. The annotated images and associated annotations can be used for fracture-region localization and object detection, while the classified fractured and non-fractured images can be used for binary fracture classification and related medical image analysis tasks. The fractured data is split into training and testing sets in a 70:30 ratio. Dataset collection: • Source: Ashraf Memorial Hospital, Kalmunai • Capture Method: Collected from PACS (Picture Archiving and Communication System) and using a phone camera. • Anonymization: All data were rigorously anonymized to maintain confidentiality and privacy. Dataset composition: • Total Participants: 438 patients, totalling 497 images. Anterior-Posterior (AP) and Lateral (L) views were obtained from both male and female patients aged between 18 and 65 years. Variables: • Fragmentary segmental fracture: 17 • Fragmented wedge fracture: 22 • Intact segmental fracture:7 • Intact wedge fracture: 74 • Oblique fracture: 38 • Spiral fracture: 30 • Transverse fracture: 65 • Non-fracture: 244
